name: Cloudinary MCP Servers
description: Upload, search, transform and analyze images and video in Cloudinary from coding agents, and manage presets and structured metadata, through Cloudinary's MCP servers.

skills.name: Asset Management
skills.description: Uploads, searches, renames and deletes images, videos and raw files, and builds transformation URLs and derived assets.

skills.name: Environment Config
skills.description: Manages upload presets, upload mappings, named transformations, webhook notifications and streaming profiles in a product environment.

skills.name: Structured Metadata
skills.description: Defines and manages structured metadata fields, their values and conditional metadata rules for media assets.

skills.name: Content Analysis
skills.description: Runs AI content analysis on assets for automatic tagging, moderation, safety checks, object detection and recognition.
